name: Glassmorphism Metric Card
description: Frosted translucent glass card with backdrop blur, luminous border highlight, and customizable blur radius and tint opacity.

preview.caption: Interactive live preview — adjust blur strength and accent glow using the controls below.

install: Copy glass.html and glass.css into your web project.
usage: Place .otter-glass-card over a rich gradient or photo backdrop. Customize --glass-blur, --glass-accent, and --glass-radius.

verification.label: Source Reviewed & Live Sandboxed
verification.details: Pure CSS effect with graceful opaque fallback when backdrop-filter is unavailable.
